verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe GitLab Duo Agent Platform as a built-in way to delegate routine tasks to specialized AI agents. Agents turn issues into merge requests and remediate vulnerabilities, and agentic Chat can propose and implement solutions with project context across the GitLab UI, IDEs and the Duo CLI. Delegation is backed by custom agents and flows with triggers, session tracking, human-in-the-loop approvals and service-account attribution. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably in practice.
